scope_declines.name: Section 28.4.4 and Exercise 28.4.E: the termination and O-connectedness machinery for reduced projective curves over a field
scope_declines.reason: The B examples compute explicit node and cusp charts over a field and the cusp delta drop using the library's own multiplicity machinery; Vakil's general arithmetic-genus termination for projective curves over a field is a narrower independent treatment and is not needed for the arbitrary Noetherian statements of the A page.

scope_declines.name: Sec. 2 exercises: regularity of O(r) and regularity in short exact sequences
scope_declines.reason: These are consistency exercises stating no result the packet promises; the exact-sequence direction is absorbed into the long-exact-sequence steps of the two regularity items.

scope_declines.name: Sec. 2 Lemmes 2.5 and 2.6: bounded quotient modules and coefficient minorations
scope_declines.reason: These lemmas serve only the printed esquisse of the boundedness theorem; the packet's direct regularity induction replaces that route, so they are recorded as history rather than built.

scope_declines.name: Lemma 54.15.5's auxiliary input Lemma 54.4.1 (making a point-supported ideal invertible by blowups) is not needed in this pair's reduced-curve scope: a reduced curve on a regular surface is already an effective Cartier divisor, so the total transform is Cartier from the start
scope_declines.reason: The pair resolves reduced curves (pure dimension one); non-reduced or embedded-point parts of the general 54.15.6 statement and its Lemma 54.4.1 machinery are deliberately not built and not claimed.

scope_declines.name: Sec. 3 Lemma 3.1: base change without flatness, with a bound depending on the morphism
scope_declines.reason: The packet needs a single N independent of the test morphism for flat families; a map-dependent bound could not define the classifying morphism, and the flat-family theorem covers every use.

scope_declines.name: Sec. 1: the Quot functor for coherent quotients of a finite sum of twists
scope_declines.reason: The commissioned AG-MOD-1 contract is the Hilbert functor of embedded closed subschemes; general coherent quotients of a finite sum are not promised on this page and the packet deliberately fixes E = O_X.

scope_declines.name: Sec. 2 Lemme 2.4: Chow-coordinate boundedness of reduced subschemes of bounded degree
scope_declines.reason: The Chow-coordinate route to boundedness is not used: the packet proves the uniform regularity bound directly by hyperplane induction, so this key lemma is recorded as the historical alternative.

scope_declines.name: Alterations and the general resolution-of-singularities formalism of Section 54.13 (Lemma 54.13.1) are not used; only the finite-normalization hypothesis and the equivalence with point-blowup regularization enter
scope_declines.reason: No resolution of singularities in dimension greater than two is asserted, per the design row and the owner direction.

scope_declines.name: Sec. 6: some variants and applications (Picard schemes and related constructions)
scope_declines.reason: The commissioned AG-MOD-1 contract ends at Hilbert and Quot existence; Picard-scheme applications belong to later pairs and are not promised or built by this batch.

scope_declines.name: Section 28.4.4 (pp. 781-782): termination of blowups at singular points of a reduced projective curve over a field by strict decrease of the arithmetic genus, with the O-connected (Stein) comparison and Exercise 28.4.E (affine O-connected implies isomorphism)
scope_declines.reason: Vakil proves the field case for reduced projective curves using arithmetic genus, a narrower scope than this pair's arbitrary Noetherian regular surfaces; the design row states explicitly that V25 28.4.4/Ex. 28.4.E cannot close the broader claim, and the page keeps the Stacks 54.15 route for the general statements. The section remains the independent treatment for the finite-type-over-a-field specialization illustrated on the B page.
